The lounge host flagged a thought on bedding supplies after a rushed handover. Incident Report - Bedding Mix-up and Cabin Comfort Complaint

The issue started in the departure lounge when the pet holding area was short on clean bedding after a hurried transfer from storage. The lounge host noticed that the crate kit for one companion animal was not fully reset, and the bedding on hand had been swapped with a different type. The traveler on duty, Diego Mendes, spoke up right away because Luna was unsettled and the crate looked bare. The cabin team had already begun boarding, so the concern moved fast from the lounge to the gate area.

The records aide at the Companion Animal Travel Desk took the note, and the senior coordinator checked the supply log against the live handover sheet. Staff then replaced the bedding with the correct set, cleaned the crate liner, and made sure water access stayed clear. The traveler was advised to keep Luna calm while the cabin team gave a quick welfare check before departure. A separate comfort complaint came in from the cabin side about warm air near the pet row, and the crew used the same channel to pass the report forward. <<FACT F117>> The response stayed practical and direct, with the crew adjusting airflow where possible and watching the animal closely.

A short exchange followed in the thread: "records aide: the bedding issue is corrected, the crate is ready, and Luna is settled". <<FACT F113>> The traveler was told to keep the boarding pass and file any follow-up note through the usual service path if any further discomfort showed up. The senior coordinator also asked the lounge host to restock the bedding shelf before the next handover and to flag any mismatch right away instead of waiting for a second check.

Follow-up will focus on tighter handoff checks, clearer crate labels, and faster cross-team alerts when pet supplies run low. The Companion Animal Travel Desk will monitor the next few departures to make sure the same mix-up does not repeat.
